slot.brief: Find the sum of coefficients of odd/even-power terms in a product of two binomial expansions using x = 1 and x = −1 subtraction.

stem: The sum of the coefficients of even powers of $x$ in the expansion of $(1+2x)^5(3-x)^4$ is

verdicts.working: Let P(x)=(1+2x)^5(3-x)^4. The sum of its even-power coefficients is [P(1)+P(-1)]/2 = (3888-256)/2 = 1816.

solution:
For $P(x)=(1+2x)^5(3-x)^4$, the sum of coefficients of even powers is $4S_{\text{even}}=\dfrac{P(1)+P(-1)}{2}4$.
$$S_{\text{even}}=\frac{3^5\cdot2^4-4^4}{2}=\frac{3888-256}{2}=1816.$$
